text:
maria: Draft PRD for Optimize Toolkit is up for launch-gate review. Focus: batching, prefix/KV caching, quantization recommendations. Short doc + acceptance criteria + test plan. https://redwood.internal/docs/optimize-toolkit-prd (please review by EOD Wed)

alex: skimmed. overall good. two big questions: 1) rollout/fallback behavior when quantized model fails QC, 2) SLA change for dedicated vs hosted due to batching. cc @jordan @devon :eyes:

jordan: agree on rollback policy. proposal: default fallback to non-quantized variant with same weights, plus canary on 10% traffic for 24h before full rollout. acceptance criteria should include quality gate (perplexity/MAU prompt set) + latency targets.

devon: edge cases I'm worried about: very short prompts (<=6 tokens) where batching hurts latency, multi-turn with large KV cache growth, and embeddings pipelines (batching for embed calls shouldn't merge with gen batching). We should add config flags: min_batch_size, max_wait_ms, per-route cache TTLs.

sam: customer asks (from CLAIRE corp): tool should recommend quantization profile by workload (latency vs quality) and export a human-readable runbook. They want guardrails for hallucination regressions.

maria: noted. adding runbook + per-customer recommended profiles to PRD. Also adding a "redlines" section: no rollout without 3rd-party eval on our holdout prompts.

alex: acceptance criteria (draft):
- Perf: 99th percentile latency within 1.2x of baseline for gen routes when batching enabled
- Cost: 20% unit cost reduction target for typical chat workload
- Quality: evaluation set delta < 2% for primary metrics (BLEU/ROUGE/MAU score)
- Reliability: fallback to variant within 2s when quality gate fails
- Observability: dashboards for token-level cost, batch sizes, cache hit rate

jordan: test plan: add synthetic load tests for small/big prompts; regression eval harness; chaos test where cache eviction happens under memory pressure.

devon: sample config snippet I'm proposing:
```
optimize_toolkit:
  batching:
    enabled: true
    min_batch_size: 2
    max_wait_ms: 8
  caching:
    kv_cache_ttl_ms: 600000
    prefix_cache_enabled: true
  quantization:
    strategy: auto
    fallback_variant: float16
    canary_pct: 10
```

maria: love it. final ask: product needs a launch checklist (docs, SDK examples, migration guide, support runbook). Who owns docs?

sam: i'll own docs + customer runbook.

alex: i'll own rollout automation and canary infra.

jordan: i'll own eval harness + QA.

maria: ok owners assigned. next steps: update PRD with these ACs + config snippet, then async signoff by EOD Wed. If no major objections, we schedule launch-gate on Thu AM. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: deploy-preview created for PRD branch: https://ci.redwood.internal/preview/optimize-toolkit-1860123456 :white_check_mark:

maria: thanks everyone — ping me if you need the doc link again.
